content: The softmax mapping (Equation DISPLAY_FORM8) is elementwise proportional to $\exp $, therefore it can never assign a weight of exactly zero. Thus, unnecessary items are still taken into consideration to some extent. Since its output sums to one, this invariably means less weight is assigned to the relevant items, potentially harming performance and interpretability BIBREF18. This has motivated a line of research on learning networks with sparse mappings BIBREF19, BIBREF20, BIBREF21, BIBREF22.
